title: Program Leader, Tech Transformation (Mobility & Delivery + New Bets) - Field Operations
description:
**About the Role**  

  

This role sits within Field Operations and owns the conversion of manual, human\-intensive workflows across Mobility (Rides) and Delivery (Eats/Grocery) COE queues, as well as workflows supporting New Bets, into AI\-powered tools and automations. You will partner with Mobility, Delivery, and New Bets operations leaders, Product, and Engineering to design solutions where AI handles the bulk of processing across support, ops, and quality queues, freeing humans to focus on exceptions and higher\-judgment work. Given the breadth of this scope, the role requires the ability to move fluidly across multiple LOBs and quickly ramp up on unfamiliar or emerging business models.
  

  

**What You Will Do*** Own identification, prioritization, and transformation of high\-volume, high\-friction workflows across Mobility, Delivery, and New Bets COE queues into AI\-first, largely automated processes
* Build fluency in current\-state workflows across each LOB \- volumes, TAT, quality, cost\-to\-serve, failure modes \- and build the case for automation, sequencing by impact and feasibility
* Partner with Mobility, Delivery, and New Bets operations leaders, Product, and Engineering to design solutions and the human\-in\-the\-loop review experience
* Drive delivery from pilot to scaled rollout across LOBs and geographies, adapting the approach to each business's maturity and volume profile
* Define and track metrics \- automation rate, accuracy, TAT, cost\-to\-serve, capacity impact \- per LOB, and report impact to Field Ops and LOB leadership
* Act as the connective tissue between LOB leadership, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, keeping the roadmap grounded in real operational needs across businesses
* Scan the internal/external AI landscape for opportunities applicable across Mobility, Delivery, and New Bets
* Build enablement and change\-management plans tailored to each LOB's frontline teams

**Basic Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, operations strategy, consulting, or technology\-driven operations transformation, ideally across more than one business line
* Demonstrated experience partnering directly with Product and Engineering to scope, prioritize, and ship technical solutions
* Working understanding of how AI/ML and GenAI tools apply to high\-volume operational workflows across marketplace businesses, including where human review is still needed
* Strong analytical/quantitative skills \- sizing opportunities, defining success metrics, and measuring impact across multiple LOBs
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate operational pain points from different businesses into clear, buildable requirements
* Comfort managing multiple concurrent workstreams across different LOBs with a track record of shipping measurable outcomes

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience across ride\-hailing, delivery, or other on\-demand marketplace operations, or comfort ramping quickly on new/emerging business models (New Bets)
* Prior experience designing or launching human\-in\-the\-loop AI systems for support, dispatch, quality, or fraud\-adjacent operational queues
* Direct experience working with engineering on solution design \- PRDs/specs, data/API requirements, pilots, and iteration
* Familiarity with GenAI tooling (LLM APIs, agent frameworks, prompt engineering, RAG) sufficient for credible technical conversations
* Experience in a top\-tier strategy consulting firm, or in operations\-at\-scale/marketplace businesses
* Strong stakeholder management skills across multiple LOB leadership teams with differing priorities and maturity levels
Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity, especially for New Bets where workflows and volumes are still evolving  
* 

  

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  

  

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  

  

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

title: Systems Operations Senior Manager - Production Operations, AIOps, MLOps
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Systems Operations Senior Manager

**In this role, you will:**

* Manage and develop teams of analysts, associates, and less experienced managers in roles that provide technical services and support for the relevant supported systems
* Engage and influence stakeholders, internal partners, and peers in order to engineer projects, identify new products and solutions, and research solutions for existing systems
* Identify and recommend opportunities for administration and maintenance of the remote monitoring and management system, as well as the periodic system review
* Perform network assessments, security audits, and system enhancement consultations
* Determine appropriate strategy and actions of Systems Operations team to meet moderate to high risk deliverables
* Interpret and develop policies and procedures, and understand compliance and risk management requirements for supported system area
* Provide implementation support for key risk initiatives
* Collaborate with and influence all levels of professionals, analysts, or associates
* Ensure the Systems Operations team communicates with customers to keep them informed of incident progress, and notify them of impending changes or agreed outages
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for Systems Operations
* Develop and guide a culture of talent development to meet business objectives and strategy

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of Systems Engineering and Technology Architecture experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 3\+ years of management or leadership experience

**Desired Qualifications**

* Extensive experience leading large\-scale Platform Engineering, Production Operations, SRE, Observability, Automation, Database, Middleware, and Enterprise Application Support organizations.
* Demonstrated success managing globally distributed teams responsible for mission\-critical platforms and customer\-facing services.
* Strong expertise in Cloud Engineering, SRE practices, Operational Excellence, AIOps, MLOps, Automation, and Platform Modernization initiatives.
* Proven ability to drive platform reliability, resiliency, scalability, governance, and continuous service improvement across enterprise environments.
* Experience leading strategic technology transformation programs, engineering excellence initiatives, and operational governance frameworks.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to align platform investments and operational priorities to business outcomes, customer experience, and risk reduction.

 **Job Expectations**

* Lead and develop high\-performing global engineering, platform, and operational support teams responsible for delivering secure, resilient, and highly available technology services.
* Define and execute platform strategy, reliability engineering roadmaps, observability standards, automation frameworks, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Establish and govern enterprise SRE practices including Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Error Budgets, reliability metrics, and continuous improvement programs.
* Drive platform reliability and availability targets for critical SaaS and enterprise services, ensuring achievement of 99\.99%\+ service availability objectives.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Architecture, and Business stakeholders to enable scalable and resilient technology solutions.
* Champion a culture of automation and self\-healing operations by leveraging Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Ansible, AIOps, and intelligent operational tooling.
* Lead cloud transformation and modernization efforts across Azure, AWS, GCP, VMware, PCF, and hybrid environments.
* Oversee enterprise observability platforms including AppDynamics, Splunk, Grafana, ThousandEyes, BigPanda, and related monitoring ecosystems.
* Establish operational governance, release management, incident management, problem management, capacity planning, and risk management processes.
* Drive continuous improvement in operational KPIs including MTTD, MTTR, service availability, incident reduction, automation adoption, and customer experience metrics.
* Provide executive\-level reporting, platform health insights, and strategic recommendations to senior technology leadership.
* Manage platform lifecycle activities including architecture reviews, software releases, patching, upgrades, performance optimization, and technology refresh initiatives.
* Foster engineering talent through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and career development programs.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise technology standards, security controls, audit requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Deep understanding of cloud\-native architectures, microservices, APIs, distributed systems, and enterprise\-scale platform operations.
* Expertise with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, release automation, and deployment tools such as UCD, Harness, GitHub Actions, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with SQL and NoSQL technologies including Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB, and other enterprise data platforms.
* Strong knowledge of ITSM practices and tools including ServiceNow, Jira, and enterprise operational workflows.
* Experience with GitHub, Azure DevOps/TFS, or equivalent version control and software engineering platforms.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Product Operating Models, and technology delivery frameworks

**Posting End Date:**


2 Oct 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**


Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.


Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. title: Sr Operations Manager, Executive Community Relations (APAC)
description:
**About the Role**  

  

Our **Executive Community Relations (ECR)** team is Uber's white\-glove approach to providing end\-to\-end resolution across lines of business and customer types. ECR steps in on complex customer issues and failed support experiences with the goal of rebuilding trust, restoring customer loyalty, and identifying recurring issues that can be surfaced to partner teams for root\-cause investigation and improvement.  

  

The **Senior Operations Manager, ECR** is responsible for the operational performance and continuous improvement of ECR support. You will lead through Customer Support Managers and Team Leads, ensuring teams consistently deliver high\-quality customer outcomes while meeting operational KPIs, quality standards, and service\-level requirements.  

  

This role requires someone who combines strong operational discipline with excellent people leadership and customer judgment. You will stay close to frontline operations, use data and escalation trends to understand where the customer experience is breaking down, and partner with cross\-functional teams to drive meaningful improvements.  

  

**What You'll Do*** Lead and motivate teams, including Customer Support Managers, Team Leads, and Representatives, to consistently deliver against customer experience, quality, productivity, and service\-level goals.
* Develop Customer Support Managers into strong people and process leaders, creating clear accountability while coaching them to make effective decisions in complex and ambiguous situations.
* Lead the delivery of white\-glove support for complex and sensitive customer escalations, ensuring customers receive thoughtful, end\-to\-end resolution following failed support experiences.
* Uphold a high\-quality support experience through the measurement and management of customer satisfaction, resolution time, quality, and other critical operational KPIs.
* Stay connected to frontline operations and use escalation trends, customer feedback, and operational data to identify recurring pain points and potential root causes.
* Surface systemic issues to relevant partner teams and work cross\-functionally to help drive improvements to processes, policies, tools, and the broader customer experience.
* Integrate teams across multiple shifts to deliver consistent customer support and achieve service\-level requirements.
* Ensure Managers and frontline teams have clarity around priorities, goals, metrics, and decision\-making expectations.
* Act as the ECR subject\-matter expert and primary Operations point of contact for the region and/or lines of business you manage.
* Partner closely with Program, Product, and other cross\-functional teams to translate frontline operational insights into actionable improvements.
* Lead monthly business reviews with key stakeholders, highlighting performance, customer insights, emerging risks, opportunities, and clear action plans.
* Create an inspiring and inclusive culture that enables people to do their best work and develops a strong pipeline of future leaders.
* Secure the resources, tools, and cross\-functional support required for your teams to meet business objectives.

**Basic Qualifications*** 5\+ years of professional experience in a high\-volume, highly productive customer support, customer operations, or service\-industry environment.
* 3\+ years of experience managing managers and leading large operational teams.
* Experience leading customer support operations involving complex escalations, service recovery, complaints, executive escalations, or other high\-touch customer support environments.
* Demonstrated experience owning and improving operational and customer experience metrics such as CSAT, quality, resolution time, SLA, and productivity.
* Strong analytical skills with a high degree of comfort working with spreadsheets and using data to identify performance trends and opportunities.
* Demonstrated ability to set clear team goals, develop people to high levels of performance, and manage effectively through challenging situations.
* Strong judgment and the ability to make effective decisions in ambiguous, time\-sensitive customer situations.
* Excellent attention to detail, organizational, and project management skills.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with peers, cross\-functional partners, and senior leadership.
* Comfort operating in a fast\-moving environment with ambiguity and change.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience working in white\-glove support, escalations, social care, premium support, complaints, or service\-recovery operations.
* Experience partnering with Product, Program, Policy, or other cross\-functional teams to address systemic customer issues.
* Experience operating across multiple shifts, regions, or distributed support teams.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen methodologies.
* SQL experience

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Operations Manager**

**Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent  
**Location:** India  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote initially, Transitioning to hybrid or in\-office mid to late 2027

**Business Hours:** 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (\[6:30 PM to 2:30 AM] IST; IST times shift one hour when US daylight saving time changes).  
**Department:** Business Operations  
**Reports To:** Operations Specialist

**About the Role**

Our Operations Manager makes sure what the organization commits to internally actually happens, on schedule and with a record to prove it. You will own our compliance calendar, access governance, vendor management, asset register, document control and business continuity. You will report to the Chief Operating Officer and lead an Operations Specialist. This is a hands\-on role in a growing company: you will build and run the processes yourself rather than oversee a large team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the compliance calendar, including certifications, insurance renewals, statutory filings, partner requirements, document reviews and control cycles, each with an owner and a due date.
* Make sure every scheduled control runs on time and its evidence is filed within five business days, so we are always audit\-ready (SOC 2 Type II).
* Approve internal access requests, run quarterly access reviews, and keep elevated access time\-limited and properly approved.
* Manage vendors and third parties so that each one has an executed agreement, a risk rating and a review date before it touches company data.
* Own the asset estate from procurement to disposal, including licence reconciliation and equipment recovery from departing staff in three countries.
* Maintain the controlled document library and master register, and keep every document current and on its review cycle.
* Own business continuity planning and annual testing, and run the quarterly risk register review.
* Coach and develop the Operations Specialist, and flag capacity risks before a deadline is missed.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5\+ years in operations, compliance or governance, with at least 2 years managing people or owning a function.
* Hands\-on experience running compliance programs such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar audit frameworks, including control evidence and audit readiness.
* Experience with access management, vendor risk, and asset or licence management.
* Strong documentation discipline, including SOPs, registers, version control and review cycles.
* The judgement to escalate issues early rather than absorb them.
* A self\-starter who works independently, plans their own week and follows through without close supervision.
* Strong critical thinking: you question whether a process actually works, spot gaps before they become problems, and bring solutions, not just issues.
* Zoho One experience is strongly preferred (WorkDrive, Projects, Desk, Books). Candidates without Zoho experience who show strong judgement and learn systems quickly will also be considered.
* Able to work US Eastern business hours consistently. This is a night\-shift role in India.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* A background in managed IT services or technology companies.
* Experience with multi\-entity or multi\-country organizations.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Submit your resume through Indeed. Please include a short note describing a compliance or control process you personally built or ran, and what you used to evidence it.

Pay: From ₹92,321\.90 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

title: Assistant Vice President, Global Managed Services Operations (India)
description:
**Assistant Vice President, Global Managed Services Operations (India)**

**Location:** India (Remote)


**Employment Type:** Full\-Time


**About Altera Digital Health**

Altera Digital Health is a global healthcare technology company committed to advancing the future of healthcare through innovative software, services, and managed solutions. Our portfolio includes Sunrise™, Paragon®, TouchWorks® EHR, dbMotion™, HealthQuest™, Ventus™, Altera Opal™, and other solutions that support healthcare organizations worldwide.


Altera is part of Harris Computer and operates within Constellation Software Inc. (CSI), one of the world's most successful software organizations. CSI is a global provider of mission\-critical software and services serving customers across dozens of industries worldwide and is recognized as one of the largest vertical market software companies globally. Backed by CSI's long\-term investment philosophy and commitment to operational excellence, Altera offers the stability, scale, and innovation needed to shape the future of healthcare technology and adjacent emerging markets.


At the intersection of technology and human outcomes, Altera is helping organizations transform operations, improve performance, and deliver better experiences for patients, caregivers, and consumers around the world.


**Position Summary**

Altera Digital Health is seeking an accomplished **Assistant Vice President, Global Managed Services Operations** to serve as the senior executive leader for our India\-based Managed Services organization.


Reporting to executive leadership, this role will be responsible for overseeing a large\-scale global delivery organization supporting healthcare IT and other emerging technology markets. The successful candidate will provide strategic leadership for service delivery, operational excellence, financial performance, workforce development, client satisfaction, and digital transformation initiatives.


This executive will act as both a hands\-on client\-facing leader and an organizational leader responsible for building, developing, and inspiring high\-performing teams. The role requires deep experience in **IT Consulting, Managed Services, Professional Services, or Outsourcing organizations** , along with a proven track record of leading complex global operations and driving organizational transformation.


The ideal candidate will combine strong business acumen, operational discipline, market awareness, and a passion for innovation, particularly in leveraging Artificial Intelligence to enhance service delivery, productivity, client outcomes, and employee effectiveness.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Serve as the executive leader for Altera's India Managed Services operations.
* Develop and execute a multi\-year strategy that aligns with corporate objectives, market opportunities, and client needs.
* Partner with executive leadership to identify global growth opportunities across healthcare IT and emerging technology markets.
* Drive continuous operational transformation and organizational maturity.

**Client Executive Engagement**

* Build trusted executive\-level relationships with clients across North America, Europe, Asia\-Pacific, and other global markets.
* Act as a strategic advisor to customers regarding service optimization, digital transformation, AI adoption, and operational improvement opportunities.
* Ensure exceptional client satisfaction, retention, and expansion outcomes.
* Participate in executive business reviews, client escalations, and strategic planning sessions.

**Managed Services \& Operational Excellence**

* Lead large\-scale delivery teams responsible for application services, managed services, consulting services, support operations, and professional services engagements.
* Establish best\-in\-class delivery practices, governance models, service management processes, and operational controls.
* Utilize metrics, KPIs, and analytics to drive accountability, efficiency, quality, and client outcomes.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

**Financial \& Business Leadership**

* Own P\&L performance for assigned business functions, delivery organizations, and cost centers.
* Leverage new technologies to drive revenue growth, profitability, margin expansion, resource optimization, and operational efficiencies.
* Support sales, solutioning, pricing strategy, and business development initiatives.
* Identify and manage organizational, operational, financial, and delivery risks.

**AI \& Digital Transformation Leadership**

* Lead the organization's evolution toward greater adoption of Artificial Intelligence and automation capabilities.
* Develop strategies to improve service delivery effectiveness through generative AI, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and emerging technologies.
* Champion innovation while establishing practical governance, adoption frameworks, and measurable business outcomes.
* Enable teams to leverage AI as a force multiplier for productivity, quality, and customer value.

**People Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing management team and global workforce.
* Build leadership pipelines and succession plans to support sustained organizational growth.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and performance\-oriented culture.
* Establish clear objectives, accountability measures, coaching practices, and professional development programs.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of progressive leadership experience in IT Services, Managed Services, Professional Services, Consulting, Outsourcing, or related technology organizations.
* 10\+ years leading large\-scale global delivery teams and client\-facing operations.
* 7\+ years of executive leadership experience with responsibility for P\&L management, organizational performance, and strategic planning.
* Demonstrated success leading geographically distributed teams serving global clients.
* Strong executive presence with ability to engage effectively with customers, industry leaders, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience driving operational transformation and process improvement initiatives.
* Track record of developing high\-performing teams and leadership talent.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing revenue, margins, utilization, and operational metrics.
* Deep understanding of service delivery frameworks, governance models, staffing strategies, and customer success programs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within Healthcare IT, IT Infrastructure, Digital Health, Electronic Health Records (EHR), Clinical Systems, Revenue Cycle, or Adjacent Healthcare Technology markets.
* Experience supporting other regulated industries and emerging technology markets.
* Proven experience driving AI, automation, and digital transformation programs.
* Experience working within large consulting organizations, managed services providers, healthcare technology firms, or global outsourcing companies.
* Knowledge of ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or other service management frameworks.
* MBA, Master's Degree, or equivalent advanced education preferred.
* Strong understanding of global market trends impacting Managed Services, Healthcare Technology, Artificial Intelligence, and Digital Transformation.

description:
